comparison_class.definition: Instances of a single C-suite open-market purchase alongside routine, scheduled insider sales
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest analogue distinguishing a genuine discretionary buy from concurrent noise-level sales

thesis: The CTO's open-market purchase is a genuine discretionary buy, not a scheduled disposal, and open-market purchases are the strongest single-transaction signal in this seat's grammar. The concurrent CFO and director sales are correctly discounted: one is a routine Rule 10b5-1 sale carrying near-zero information, and the other is a single director sale, both weaker categories. Net read leans mildly bullish on the strength of the one real signal present.
what_would_change_my_mind: If the CTO's purchase were itself revealed to be plan-driven rather than discretionary, this read would drop to NO_READ.
